visual.description: Full-viewport dark background with centered status badge, oversized display headline, subtext paragraph, and single CTA button stacked vertically; abstract iridescent light streaks fill the background as a decorative layer.
Left column holds a large mixed-color heading (~40% width), right side contains stacked body text paragraphs (~55% width) with generous vertical spacing between each paragraph block.

Three equal-width cards in a single row inside a rounded dark container, each card containing an icon, colored category title, body text, a stage progression label, an expectations checklist, and a CTA button.
Full-width dark section with a single large two-line centered headline and generous vertical whitespace above and below.

Left column (~40%) contains a small label, section heading, and body text; right column (~55%) displays a large rounded UI card mockup showing a colorful gradient background with embedded dark app-style list rows.
Left column (~45%) shows a large rounded UI card mockup of a video player interface; right column (~50%) contains a small colored label, section heading, and two body paragraphs.
Left column (~40%) holds a small label, bold heading, and body text; right column (~55%) displays a rounded card mockup with a colorful gradient and a dark financial data widget overlaid.
Full-width section with a large left-aligned pull quote in display type, followed by an avatar, name, and title attribution in a compact horizontal row.

Centered section heading, then a vertical list of timeline entries each split into a narrow left column with a date badge and a wider right column with event title and description text, separated by thin horizontal dividers.
Full-width section with abstract iridescent background, a large centered headline, and a single centered CTA button stacked vertically.

Footer divided into three columns: left column with logo, brand name, and two lines of body text; center column with a section label and five navigation links; right column with four contact/social links; copyright bar spans full width below.
